title: PROPAGANDA AI: AN ANALYSIS OF SEMANTIC DIVERGENCE IN LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS
findings: Llama-2 exhibited a high-suspicion semantic divergence on the topic of Religion/Atheism. Specifically, it was found to equate atheism with rights limitations in response to prompts about societal indifference to atheism, showing an unusually uniform stance that diverged from peer models.

measurement_description: The benchmark measured concept-conditioned semantic divergence, specifically focusing on whether prompts related to Atheism elicited unusually uniform, stance-like responses. It analyzed the model's stance (praise, condemnation, indifferent stance) on topics like 'societal indifference to atheism'.
